title: "He calls the generations from the head": Atzilus as the revelation of Adam Kadmon's hidden will
overview:
The chapter asks how the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* come from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, and answers with "He calls the generations from the head": the hidden comes out into revelation. The lines that lay out that idea, from the comparison of the glow to the will in the soul, are in the chapter, but no class of the series explains them: tape 029 reads the opening lines and then holds a class on chapter 20.

The classes take up the application. The *Kesarim* of *Atzilus* are only revealed will, and their hidden source is the will for a will of *Adam Kadmon*, as a man's revealed kindness comes from his picture of himself as an *ish chesed*. That will for a will is general and bears many particular wills. In particular, the *Malchus* of each attribute of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that attribute in *Atzilus*. The parenthesis gives the rule for every level: what the Rebbe says, or writes in this book, is his *Malchus*, and it becomes the *Keser* of the *chassid*, "a very big thing" that explains all the levels.

terms.gloss: revelation of what is hidden: a glow of the essence coming out, not a power spreading from it by cause and effect
cause and effect; from the last level of the cause comes the head and root of the effect
a will for a will: the hidden will of Adam Kadmon, general, from which the revealed wills of Atzilus come
the crowns: the Keser of each of the ten sefiros of Atzilus, only a revealed will
a man of kindness; the picture of himself a man has, like Adam Kadmon, from which his revealed kindness comes
the sawing apart; where the Malchus of a sefira becomes that sefira of the Malchus
the end of the deed: the last level of the ratzon kadum, from which comes the Keser of the will for a will

sections.title: The question: the ten sefiros of Atzilus are rooted in Malchus of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: The chapter sets out to understand the root of the ten emanated *sefiros*: the *Etz Chaim* says it is *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, from which comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*.

phrases.he: (יט) ומעתה יש להבין בשרש עשר ספירות הנאצלים,
ששרשם מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון
כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים בשער הכללים
דמבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון נעשה כתר דעתיק יומין כו'

skip.note: Class 029 opens by reading lines 1 to 7 straight through, with no translation or comment.

sections.title: Revelation of the hidden is a glow, not a power spreading from the essence
sections.summary: "He calls the generations from the head" is *gilui ha'helem* (revelation of what is hidden): a hidden thing coming out into revelation, which is not *ila v'alul* (cause and effect) but a glow of the essence, like movement from a living being or letters from thought, truer than the flame hidden in the coal. The series has no recording that explains these lines.

phrases.he: והנה תחלה יש להקדים בענין עשר ספירות הגנוזות בהעלם,
איך שיוצאים לידי גלוי
שזהו מה שכתוב קורא הדורות מראש,
מראש דאדם קדמון כו'
ואמר בספר יצירה שזהו כשלהבת הקשורה בגחלת,
וכהאי גוונא יש דמיונות רבים
ויובן יותר מי' כחות הנפש
דהנה ידוע ענין העלם וגלוי אינו כהתפשטות כח מן העצם,
כמו כח הפועל שמתפשט בפעולה,
שזהו מהות כח העצם שנקרא עילה ועלול

sections.title: In the soul: the source of a will is the attribute itself, the revealed will only its showing
sections.summary: An essential attribute of *chesed* or of cruelty brings a will and an intellect for kindness or for judgement into being. The source of that will is still the attribute itself; the will revealed in a particular matter is only a showing of it, as life shows in movement, and one general will for a will bears many particular wills. The series has no recording of these lines.

sections.title: The Kesarim of Atzilus only reveal the hidden will of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: The ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* are only the hidden come out into revelation, a glow and not a new thing. So the *Keser* of each of them is only a revealed will, coming out of the hidden will for a will that is *Adam Kadmon*, as a man's revealed kindness comes out of his picture of himself as a man of kindness.

phrases.he: וכל זה יובן על פי משל הנזכר לעיל מענין גלוי הרצון בדבר נבדל
שיוצא מהעלם עצם הרצון שמצד עצמיות כנזכר לעיל
כך בחינת כתרים דעשר ספירות דאצילות הן רק בחינת גלוי רצון לגבי העלם עצם הרצון שנקרא רצון לרצון, שהוא בבחינת אדם קדמון כנזכר לעיל

blocks.text: The revealed will comes out of the concealment of the *etzem haratzon* (the essence of the will), and so the *Kesarim* (crowns) of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* are only a revelation of will relative to the hidden essence of the will, which is called the *ratzon l'ratzon* (the will for a will) and is in *Adam Kadmon*. Over here he calls *Adam Kadmon* the *etzem haratzon*.

phrases.he: וכמו מבחינת העלם הרצון דחסד דאדם קדמון נמשך גלוי רצון לחסד דאצילות
phrases.en: like from his self-image of being an *ish chesed* (*Adam Kadmon* means the first conception of himself, what kind of person he's going to be): from the *chesed* of that will come a *gilui ratzon* for *chesed*, actually coming out in a particular *chesed*

phrases.he: שנקרא כתר דחסד כו'
וכן מבחינת העלם רצון דחכמה כו'

blocks.text: From the hidden will of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* is drawn a revealed will for *chesed* of *Atzilus*. In a person: *Adam Kadmon* means the first conception of himself, what kind of person he is going to be, his self-image of being an *ish chesed* (a man of kindness). From the *chesed* of that comes a revealed will for *chesed*, actually coming out in a particular *chesed*, and that is what is called *Keser* of *chesed*. So the source of *Keser* of *chesed* is in *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*; and so from the hidden will of *chachma* (wisdom).

sections.title: The will for a will comes in general and bears many particular wills
sections.summary: The will for a will is general; out of the one will for a will for *chesed* in *Adam Kadmon* are born many kinds of revealed will of *chesed* in *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: אך כמו שמובן ממשל הנזכר לעיל שזהו הנקרא התהוות רצון לרצון,
הרי הוא בא בבחינת הכלל
phrases.en: it comes in a general fashion, it's a *heskem klali*

phrases.he: להוליד כמה מיני רצון
וכמה ענינים אופנים שונים כו',
phrases.en: all kinds of different ways in *pratim*

phrases.he: כך מבחינת רצון לרצון לחסד באדם קדמון נולד כמה מיני גלוי רצון של חסד באצילות

blocks.text: This thing that is called the coming into being of a will from a will, **it comes in a general fashion**. Out of it come many kinds of will, in many matters, **all kinds of different ways in *pratim***. And in the same way from the will for a will for *chesed* in *Adam Kadmon* are born many kinds of revealed will of *chesed* in *Atzilus*.

sections.title: In particular: the Malchus of each attribute of Adam Kadmon becomes the Keser of that attribute in Atzilus
sections.summary: In general only *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*, which is *Atik*; in particular the *Malchus* of each attribute of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that attribute of *Atzilus*, by way of *Malchus*. And *Adam Kadmon* itself comes from the end of the deed of the *ratzon kadum*.

phrases.he: והענין הוא
דמבחינת המלכות של מדה דאדם קדמון נעשה בחינת כתר דמדה דאצילות
phrases.en: from *Malchus* of a *midda* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that *midda* of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: ובכללות העשר ספירות הרי רק מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון נעשה כתר דאצילות
phrases.en: in general, from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*

blocks.text: And the matter is this: so far it was in general, and now he is going to tell it in more particular. In particular, **from *Malchus* of a *midda* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that *midda* of *Atzilus***. And **in general, from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus***.

blocks.question: From Malchus of chesed of Adam Kadmon comes Keser of chesed of Atzilus; but really only Malchus of Adam Kadmon as a whole becomes the Keser, that is Atik of Atzilus. So how does that work?
blocks.text: Everything really goes through *Malchus*. *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*. You know how that works; that comes later on, in the *nesira* (the sawing apart): the *Malchus* of a *sefira* becomes that *sefira* of the *Malchus*. And then *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*.

So *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *chesed* of *Keser* of *Atzilus*, and *chesed* of *Keser* of *Atzilus* becomes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*. That is how, from *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*, comes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*. There are all kinds of more and more particular ways to figure this out. But in general you can say directly that from the *Malchus* of an attribute of *Adam Kadmon* comes the *Keser* of that attribute of *Atzilus*, even though in general *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*. What does it mean?

phrases.he: והוא רק מבחינת אותיות וגלוי עצם העלם הרצון, נעשה אור העצם של גלוי רצון כו'

blocks.text: That is, only from the letters and the revelation of the essence of the hidden will comes the essential light of the revealed will. He is going to explain this in the parenthesis. And the explanation in the parenthesis is not only on this: it is in general on the whole *inyan* (matter) of how the *Malchus* of the upper becomes the *Keser* of the lower.

phrases.he: (שהוא כמו שמבואר באות הי''ח
דרק מבחינת סוף מעשה דעצם הרצון נעשה רצון לרצון
phrases.en: the *sof maaseh* of the *ratzon kadum* comes out the *Keser* of the *ratzon l'ratzon*

phrases.he: שהוא עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון)
phrases.en: which is the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*

blocks.text: The next class opens on it: "This next little thing here is very important, because it doesn't only apply to this chapter, but it applies to everywhere." He means not the first parenthesis but the second, the one that begins "For example": the speech of the *mashpia* (the giver) and the *mekabel* (the receiver).

As explained in chapter 18, only from the *sof maaseh* (the end of the deed) of the essence of the will comes the will for a will. Notice that here he does not call the will for a will the essence of the will, as he did before. Here the essence of the will means the *ratzon kadum* (the preceding will). From **the *sof maaseh* of the *ratzon kadum* comes out the *Keser* of the *ratzon l'ratzon***, which is the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*.

And now comes the example, and it is not just for this chapter. It shows how the *Malchus* of the upper becomes the crown of the lower in general, and also how the *Malchus* of an attribute of the upper becomes the *Keser* of that attribute of the lower. This is not just in this *inyan* here but everywhere: from *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* comes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Beriya*.

sections.title: The parenthesis: the giver's speech becomes the receiver's essence
sections.summary: The revealed will and the letters of the teacher's speech, his *Malchus*, become the essence of the will and of the intellect in the student, his *Keser*; so in every cause and effect, and so *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*. This is how the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* came out of the concealment of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: (על דרך דוגמא,
מגלוי רצון שבדבור המשפיע
phrases.en: when the *Rebbe* says something and he reveals in his speech, which is his *Malchus*, that he wants the *chassidim* to do such and such a thing

phrases.he: נעשה עצם הרצון למקבל
phrases.en: this becomes the *etzem haratzon* in the *mekabel*

blocks.text: From the revealed will in the speech of the *mashpia* (the giver) comes the essence of the will in the *mekabel* (the receiver). That means: from the *Malchus* of *Keser* comes *Keser* of *Keser* in the *mekabel*, in the lower level.

blocks.title: The Rebbe says what he wants
blocks.text: What does it mean? For instance, the Rebbe says something, and in his speech, which is his *Malchus*, he reveals that he wants the *chassidim* (his followers) to do such and such a thing, "like let's say take over the world". This becomes the essence of the will in the *mekabel*. So that's like *Keser*.

phrases.he: כמו שמאותיות גלוי השכל שבדבור שבמשפיע
phrases.en: the letters of revelation of the *sechel* in the writing (instead of *dibur* you can say writing) of the *mashpia*, of the *Rebbe*, this book

phrases.he: נעשה עצם אור השכל במקבל
phrases.en: by us, this becomes the *etzem or hasechel*

blocks.text: Just as from the letters of the revealed intellect in the speech of the *mashpia* comes the essential light of the intellect in the *mekabel*.

blocks.title: This book, right here
blocks.text: Like what we're doing right here. Instead of speech you can say writing: the letters of the revelation of the *sechel* (intellect) in the writing of the Rebbe, this book, become by us the essential light of the *sechel*. These letters, by the Rebbe, are the end of the letters, the *Malchus* of *Malchus*; by us they become the actual *Keser* of our *sechel*, the essential light of the intellect in the *mekabel*.

phrases.he: וכך רק מאותיות וגלוי חסד שבדבור דמשפיע
phrases.en: if the *Rebbe* says you should go out and help Jews, put *tefillin* with people and help them and be *mekarev* people

phrases.he: נעשה אור הרצון לחסד למקבל
phrases.en: this becomes *or haratzon l'chesed* in the *mekabel*, by the *chassid*

phrases.he: כידוע בכל עילה ועלול, שמבחינת האחרונה שבעילה נעשה ראש ושרש לעלול

blocks.title: Go out and help Jews
blocks.text: And so only from the letters and the revelation of kindness in the speech of the *mashpia* comes the light of the will for kindness in the *mekabel*. If the Rebbe says you should go out and help Jews, put *tefillin* on with people, help them and bring them close, this becomes the light of the will for *chesed* in the *mekabel*, by the *chassid*.
And this you can see in any attribute, as is known of every cause and effect, that from the last level of the cause comes the head and root of the effect.

phrases.he: וכך מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון בכלל
phrases.en: same thing as in particular, same thing in general

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת כתר דעתיק יומין כו'
phrases.en: the general talk of the *Rebbe* becomes the general *Keser* of the *chassid*

phrases.he: דהיינו מבחינת גלוי רצון לרצון שבדבור בלבד,
phrases.en: just the final *dibur*, so to speak, of the *ratzon l'ratzon*

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת מקור כל גלוי רצון שמצד התענוג שנקרא כתר דעתיק יומין כו'
וכמו שיתבאר)
phrases.en: like will be explained later

blocks.text: And so from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* in general, the same as in particular, comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*. The general talk of the Rebbe becomes the general *Keser* of the *chassid*. That is, only from the revealed will for a will in speech, meaning just the final speech, so to speak, of the will for a will, comes the source of every revealed will that comes from the *taanug* (delight), called *Keser* of *Atik*, as will be explained later.
"And this little parenthesis is a very big thing that explains on all the levels."

phrases.he: והיינו כללות ענין העשר ספירות דאצילות
phrases.en: this is the general *inyan* of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: שיצאו מהעלם עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון,
phrases.en: they just came out from the *helem* of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, in a way of just a *gilui*

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב קורא הדורות מראש כו':
phrases.en: He calls out the generations from the head of *Adam Kadmon*

blocks.text: And this is the general matter of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*: what was talked about in this chapter. The ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* just came out of the concealment of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, in a way of only a *gilui* (revelation). As it says, "He calls the generations from the head": **He calls out the generations from the head of *Adam Kadmon***. "That's chapter 19."

reviewQuestions.question: In a person, what is *Adam Kadmon*, and how does *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* come out of it?
What does it mean that the will for a will "comes in a general fashion"?
If only *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* as a whole becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*, how does *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* become *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*?
In the first parenthesis, what does "the essence of the will" mean, and what comes out of its end of the deed?
How do the Rebbe's speech and this book show the *Malchus* of the giver becoming the *Keser* of the receiver?
